# C.N.S. Paramedical and Nursing College

> Official portal of C.N.S. Paramedical and Nursing College, Lakhaiyamau, Gursahaiganj Road, Samdhan, Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh – 209735. Established 2022.

## Academic Programs
- **ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery)**: 2-Year Full-time Diploma in primary and community healthcare.
- **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)**: 3-Year Full-time Diploma with comprehensive hospital rotations.
- **B.Sc. Nursing**: 4-Year Professional Undergraduate Degree with rotatory clinical internship.

## Campus Facilities
- Central Medical Library with textbooks, clinical journals, and e-learning stations.
- Clinical Skill Laboratories: Nursing Foundation, Anatomy & Physiology, Maternal and Child Health simulation suites.
- Smart Classrooms with audio-visual equipment.
- Multipurpose Hall & Auditorium for student ceremonies and health symposia.

- Location: Lakhaiyamau, Gursahaiganj Road, Samdhan, Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh - 209735
